description: City will acquire 159.88 acres in Northwest Saskatoon.
Purchase price is $650,000 from Esther Balaton Estate.
Over $2.2 million will transfer between various city reserves.
Funds will support parks maintenance, upgrades, and civic buildings.
City Council will amend policies and bylaws for reserves.

chips.text: Funds will benefit residents using city parks and the Albert Community Centre.

description: City Administration will monitor SREDA and Discover Saskatoon agreements.
A comprehensive review of objectives is due before agreements expire.
SREDA and Discover Saskatoon are asked to increase collaboration.
City will sell 902-912 3rd Avenue North to Vox Development.
Site is for affordable housing development, priced at $1,357,000.
2401 Broadway Avenue will be sold for market-value R2 development.

chips.text: Vox Development Ltd. will purchase 0.60 acres for affordable housing.
902-912 3rd Avenue North will become a City-owned Housing Action Plan site.

description: Council will review three information reports.
Meewasin Valley Authority's March 31, 2026 financial statements are presented.
